verdicts.citation: R1: SPEC.md 7.2 item 10, 'astro.config.mjs takes site and base from the environment ... the variables SITE_URL and BASE_PATH when they are set; otherwise, in CI, the values that follow from GITHUB_REPOSITORY ...; otherwise http://localhost and /', together with SPEC.md 7.8 item 4, which sets only 'one built with BASE_PATH=/'. R5: decisions/P6-A5.md (also DECISIONS.md line 3556), '## 2026-10-25 P6-A5: the embed page', '<link rel="canonical"> to the absolute URL of /tools/<id>/ (from Astro.site and BASE_URL)'; decisions/P6-A4.md (DECISIONS.md line 4015), Atlas downloads, 'LaTeX: latexFile('dynkin', body, <page address>) of P6-A5'; decisions/P6-A5.md '## 2026-10-25 P6-A5: the downloaded .tex file' ('% <link>' as the first comment line); build-plan/agents/GATE.md 5.7 line 197, 'Second release build: RELEASE=1 BASE_PATH=/ npm run build ... with SITE_URL unset (the archive is "served as plain files from the root of any domain", 7.8)'. R2: SPEC.md 7.8 item 4.
verdicts.evidence: Read at f07eec6 with git show. (1) SPEC 7.2 item 10 (unlabelled) gives site = http://localhost when SITE_URL is unset and the build is not in CI. SPEC 7.8 builds the root archive with only BASE_PATH=/, and GATE.md 5.7 says to build it locally 'with SITE_URL unset'. Under those rules Astro.site is http://localhost in that build. (2) site/src/pages/embed/[tool].astro sets canonical = new URL(`${base}tools/${entry.id}/`, Astro.site ?? Astro.url).href, which is exactly what the logged P6-A5 decision records ('from Astro.site and BASE_URL'). site/src/pages/atlas/[board].astro sets pageUrl = new URL(`${BASE_URL}atlas/${board}/`, Astro.site ?? Astro.url).href and passes it to latexFile, whose first line is the comment '% <link>' (P6-A5's .tex file decision; P6-A4's Atlas download decision). The 48 localhost addresses are these two logged choices applied to the site value SPEC 7.2 item 10 prescribes. (3) SPEC does not ask for either address. 7.4 'Embedding' asks only that every tool has a route /embed/<tool> for an <iframe>, with no canonical link. 6.7 defines the \dynkin and TikZ forms, with no address line. 6.6 data export lists state, engine version, git commit and tables, with no URL. (4) SPEC 7.8 item 4 says the root archive 'can be served as plain files from the root of any domain with no build step'. That sentence describes how the archive is served. The lens's own coverage shows it holds for this archive: 'Root archive under /: the same counts' (754 of 755 URLs 200, 0 outside the base), 93 browser tests passed, every island hydrated. The sentence says nothing about absolute self-addresses inside page metadata or inside a downloaded file's comment line. The finding's expected ('should never be the localhost placeholder') is not in 7.8. (5) Not R3: the embed routes, the Atlas and LaTeX export are phase 6 (9.1 row 6), at gate G6. (6) Not R6: no earlier-round or gate record names this. reports/gate-G6.md (report commit d59af4a above f07eec6; it names gate commit f07eec66...) records the root archive as 'RELEASE=1 BASE_PATH=/' with no open item on it. The known-and-decided item on 'Cite on /embed/<id>' concerns the Cite text, not the canonical link. Worktree untouched: git status --porcelain empty at f07eec6; no node_modules, no site/dist.
verdicts.reason: SPEC 7.2 item 10 makes http://localhost the site of the BASE_PATH=/ build that 7.8 and GATE 5.7 prescribe. The canonical link and the LaTeX comment address are the logged P6-A5 and P6-A4 choices ('from Astro.site and BASE_URL') applied to that value. SPEC asks for neither address, and 7.8's sentence ('served as plain files from the root of any domain with no build step') concerns serving, which the archive does; it does not regulate addresses written inside the files.

verdicts.citation: R2: SPEC.md 7.2 item 10, 'Every internal link and asset path is built from import.meta.env.BASE_URL. One browser test runs the site built with BASE_PATH=/sub/path/, to catch a link that was typed with a leading slash'; SPEC.md 7.8 item 4, 'can be served as plain files from the root of any domain with no build step'; SPEC.md 7.3, '<Cite k="Don08"/> renders the key in square brackets as a link to that entry on the sources page'. R5: DECISIONS.md line 280, '## 2026-10-10 P0-A4: anchor contracts for P1-A4', '<Cite k="X"> links to <base>sources#X ... <Unverified item="E4"> links to <base>open-items#E4', and line 277 ('href="<base>sources#<k>"'); DECISIONS.md line 1227, P2-A4 provenance predicate, 'linked to BASE/sources#GSS12'; DECISIONS.md line 2762, '## 2026-10-17 RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b: the internal-link check of the build (P3-RT-12-01)', 'one that names no file of the build (directory and .html forms accepted, as GitHub Pages and astro preview serve them)'; SPEC.md 7.7 commands, 'npm run e2e (Playwright against astro preview ...)'.
verdicts.evidence: Read at f07eec6. (1) The href form is the contracted and logged one. The plan's P0-A4 instruction (build-plan/agents/P0-A4-content-components.md:145) prescribes href="<base>sources#Don08". P0-A4 logged it as the anchor contract (DECISIONS.md 277, 280), with open-items#<id> for <Unverified>. P2-A4 logged T15's link as BASE/sources#GSS12 (line 1227), as its instruction (P2-A4 plan line 154) says: '${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}sources#GSS12'. Tests at the gate pin the form: content-components.test.ts:345 href="/sub/path/sources#${key}", :381 'href="/sources#Don08"'; links-internal.test.ts:39 uses ${base}sources#Don08 as a valid link. Cite.astro:18 builds it from BASE_URL, joined with one slash. (2) The build's link check accepts this form by a logged decision: RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b (DECISIONS.md 2762) records 'directory and .html forms accepted, as GitHub Pages and astro preview serve them', and scripts/links.mjs:181 tries [rel, rel.html, rel/index.html] for a path without a trailing slash. 'No gate check sees it' is therefore the documented behaviour of the check, not a check proving less than it says. SPEC 7.7 itself names astro preview as the server of npm run e2e. (3) The SPEC sentences cited do not require a 200 with no redirect. The link is built from BASE_URL and does not start with a bare '/' (7.2 item 10). It leads to the sources entry (7.3). The archive is served as plain files with no build step (7.8). The finding's own observed value is '301 /mutation_game/sources/', the server's directory redirect to the built page, and a fragment with no fragment in Location is kept across the redirect. The 'any that returns other than 200' standard is the lens's plan text (RT-12 attack 11), whose standard sentence is the leading-slash sentence of 7.2 item 10, which this link meets. The lens's own attack on the release archives as plain files (attack 34, standard SPEC 7.8) fails only on 'a 404 for any internal URL'. (4) Not R3 (Cite and the sources page are phase 0 and 1, gate G6). Not R6: no record; the phase 5 RT-12 coverage reported '115 of 115 URLs answer 200' under /sub/path/ and no finding. Worktree untouched (git status --porcelain empty).
verdicts.reason: <base>sources#<key> and <base>open-items#<id> are the logged anchor contract of P0-A4, which P2-A4 reused and the tests at the gate pin. The build's link check accepts the directory form by the logged RT-FIX-P3-toolchain-b decision 'as GitHub Pages and astro preview serve them'. The cited SPEC passages (7.2 item 10 BASE_URL and leading slash, 7.3 a link to the entry, 7.8 served as plain files) are met by a link that a static host answers with a 301 to the built page. The 'every URL answers 200' standard comes from the lens file, not from SPEC.
